status: Predictions registered before individual-change ablation runs
prior_evidence: Not blinded: earlier combined changes improved ring-to-discard from about 6.9k to 8.65k completed RPS. No individual-change ablation results have been observed.

design.base: Corrected preallocated SPSC enqueue, raw byte copy, consumer polling
secondary_metrics: Consumer wakeups, empty scans, and messages per nonempty read
design.interpretation: Restore one cost at a time on the corrected base. The legacy variant restores all four hot-path costs to reveal interactions. Three runs are exploratory, not a precise confidence interval.

predictions.investigate_if_unexpected: Check storage warnings, HTTP failures, missed arrivals, scheduler lag, and host load before attributing differences to code.

predictions.change: Restore MPSC CAS reservation on each otherwise single-writer ring
predictions.reason: There is only one actual producer per ring, so CAS should not contend with another producer.
predictions.investigate_if_unexpected: Inspect retry counts and cache-line contention; verify single-writer ownership.

predictions.change: Restore the per-message MemoryRegionSection allocation through Writer.try_write(ByteRange)
predictions.reason: Small allocations are producer-local and the serialized data buffer remains reused.
predictions.investigate_if_unexpected: Inspect allocator samples, allocation size/count, and producer CPU.

predictions.change: Restore coalesced producer WorkBeacon notifications and a notification-waiting consumer
predictions.expected_impact: High: largest individual effect, roughly 10-25% throughput loss
predictions.reason: This reintroduces mutex/futex work and producer-consumer scheduling handoffs. This prediction covers the notification policy, not only the mutex.
predictions.investigate_if_unexpected: Compare actual notifications, consumer wakeups, batch sizes, and context-switch behavior.

predictions.change: Restore the consumer's mutex-protected shared-pointer queue-list copy on every scan
predictions.reason: The list is small and no producer changes it during the measured window.
predictions.investigate_if_unexpected: Inspect scan frequency, allocations, reference-count operations, and empty-read counts.

predictions.change: Restore all four hot-path costs above
predictions.reason: The previous combined implementation lost about 20%. Effects need not add linearly.
predictions.investigate_if_unexpected: Check interactions between notification timing and consumer scan/batch frequency, then compare the diagnostic implementation with the original.

not_independently_identifiable_in_this_s.change: Lazy queue allocation and first-use registration versus startup preallocation
not_independently_identifiable_in_this_s.reason: All fixed producer threads have emitted before measurement; this is a startup-path difference.
Healthy 1MiB-ring runs previously reported no trace drops. The logging path is not exercised; a separate constrained-ring stress test is required.
